STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

Whether Mr. P.M. Jayantha working as a Conductor of the Amabalanthota Depot of the Sri Lanka Transport Board had been caused injustice by not being given the requests/allowances mentioned from (i) to (v) below and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
(i) Payments not being made for unavailed leave from 2015 to 2022

(ii) Not being given the opportunity to report to work at Ambalanthota Depot from 18.12.2020 to 31.12.2020 when he had been transferred from the Kataragama Depot to Ambalantota Depot through disciplinary order No. Y%S,x.u$iudil$úkh$reyqKqm%d$159/2020 dated 23.11.2020 and there by deprival of salary from 18.12.2020 to 31.12.2020
(iii) Non-availing of the monthly availed 02 days duty-leave which is given for trade union activities, for the month of December 2020
(iv) 07.02.2021 and 21.02.2021 been considered as days on which he had not reported to work.
